idea-plugin.name: Nova Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Nova is a vibrant, space-inspired theme built for the Islands UI and tuned for Go development.

Editor and tool windows float as rounded islands over a deep-space canvas, while the syntax palette bursts with supernova energy: magenta keywords, electric cyan variables, nebula purple types, star gold functions and aurora green strings.

Six variants:

  • Nova Dark: deep-space navy islands over a near-black cosmic canvas.
  • Nova Light: bright stellar islands with the same high-energy accents, contrast-corrected for daylight.
  • Nova Dark High Contrast: pure black canvas and brighter accents for high-glare screens and accessibility.
  • Nova Dim: a softer, lower-contrast dark variant for long sessions.
  • Nova Dark Classic and Nova Light Classic: the same palettes without the Islands layout, for the classic New UI look.

Go-specific highlighting covers struct tags, build constraints, struct versus interface references, method receivers, shadowed variables, builtin values, doc comment references and go fix syntax updates, plus Go templates.

Full IDE coverage beyond the editor: the block terminal, the profiler tool window with flame graphs and CPU/memory charts, line profiling gutters, the debugger with inline values, test coverage gutters, VCS file status and annotations, inlay hints, AI inline suggestions and next-edit highlights, diff and merge, plus YAML, JSON, Markdown, Terraform HCL, Protobuf, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, SQL, HTTP client and regular expressions.

Ships with the Commit Mono coding font (SIL OFL 1.1) with ligatures. The font is registered automatically and offered through a notification the first time a Nova scheme is active, so your editor font is never changed without asking.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0
  • New variants: Nova Dark High Contrast, Nova Dim, Nova Dark Classic and Nova Light Classic.
  • Theming for the profiler tool window: flame graphs, CPU and memory charts, line profiling gutters.
  • Theming for the block terminal, including its own ANSI palette, block backgrounds and error strokes.
  • Go highlighting extended to struct tags, build constraints, interfaces versus structs, builtin variables, comment references, go fix syntax updates and Go templates.
  • Debugger, test coverage, inlay hints, breadcrumbs, bookmarks and live template colors.
  • AI inline suggestions, inline prompt and next-edit diff colors.
  • VCS file status colors, annotation stripes and merge status colors.
  • Language coverage for YAML, JSON, Markdown, Terraform HCL, Protobuf, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, SQL, HTTP client, XML, HTML, CSS and regular expressions.
  • Islands compact metrics, alternative window backgrounds, badges, banners and project gradients.
  • The bundled Commit Mono font is now opt-in through a notification and is no longer installed into the user font directory.
1.0.1
  • Initial release with Nova Dark and Nova Light variants.
  • Built on the Islands UI (2025.2+).
